task: Wrap FileAnalysisConfig.chat_model in pydantic SkipJsonSchema so model_json_schema() succeeds and GET /v1/tools/configs returns fileanalysisconfig without an ERROR log, with regression tests for the schema and real config discovery.

key_reasoning.reason: Fix is a one-field type annotation change using standard pydantic SkipJsonSchema (available in the pinned 2.13.5, already verified on a copy of the class). No exact in-repo precedent (Field(exclude=True) is the existing convention), and runtime callers in the file-analysis toolkit and toolkit service must still accept a BaseChatModel and keep it excluded from model_dump, so S rather than XS. No security surface involved.
Acceptance criteria and suggested fix are explicit. One minor point to settle: the ticket's 'filesanalysisconfig' key is a typo; the provider emits 'fileanalysisconfig'.
One source file (file_analysis models) plus regression tests in the file-analysis tests and toolkit-provider tests: about 3 files across the source and tests trees.

Single field on a single config model; toolkit provider and tools router are verification surfaces only, unchanged. Score 9 sits at the XS/S boundary; leaned lower because Technical Risk is S and the fix is fully specified. Consistent with the bundled XS example (logging on one endpoint), slightly above it on tests and clarity.
